app.name: Gekko2 Wii Limits
app.long_description: Standalone Wii benchmark. Press A to start; HOME or GameCube START cancels/exits. Saves separate measurements to sd:/gekko2-bench. No BIOS or games needed. No clock, IOS or emulator configuration changes. Synthetic workloads are not theoretical maxima, game FPS or full hardware conformance. Real Wii boot and measurements remain to be supplied by the owner.
